author: Drake
diagnosis: Early psychosis: primary psychosis with substance use, or substance-induced psychosis
n_total_basis: eligible baseline sample (400 recruited, 15 not meeting criteria; journal p. 111)
outcome_definition: Current competitive employment at the 12-month interview (Table 3: 102 workers, 193 non-workers)
denominator_type: employment-classified sample (102 + 193); 319 interviewed at one year
decision_a24_strict: excluded from strict primary set (A24: substance-induced psychosis 28.5% and psychotic mood disorder; no strict-eligible subgroup counts)
decision_a33: eligible under A33 (psychosis for less than six months at presentation; non-organic psychoses including substance-induced)
source_page: Drake et al. 2013, Schizophr Res 146:111-117, Table 3 (journal p. 114); candidate NU23_01
note: Overturns HK exclusion X03. Applicability: recruitment required substance use or substance-induced psychosis; limitation stated

author: Clarke
n_total_basis: randomised in the parent trial (journal p. 772); 145 analysed after one exclusion for missing QoL data
outcome_definition: Currently in paid work at the 18-month follow-up, both trial arms pooled (Table 1)
denominator_type: complete-case sample of the quality-of-life clustering analysis
decision_a24_strict: excluded from strict primary set (A24: bipolar 20/145 and MDD with psychotic features 17/145; no non-affective subgroup count)
decision_a33: eligible under A33 (EPPIC first-episode psychosis trial sample)
source_page: Clarke et al., Qual Life Res 2023;32:769-780, Table 1 (journal p. 773), sample journal p. 772; candidate NX02_02
note: Companion of Killackey 2019 (same trial cohort); overturns X02. Applicability: recruited on interest in vocational recovery, half received IPS; limitation stated

author: Nossel
diagnosis: Non-affective psychosis, onset under two years (OnTrackNY eligibility)
n_total_basis: enrolled with at least one three-month follow-up (journal p. 865)
outcome_definition: Employed (any paid employment, including internships) at the six-month follow-up; reference interval of the count not stated; period basis by RT's adjudication
denominator_type: clients with data at six-month follow-up (261 is the N of the 3-to-6-month model interval, Table 3)
vocational_exposure: all (coordinated specialty care with supported employment and education)
decision_a24_strict: excluded from strict primary set (A24: compatibility not established from the publication; no recognised diagnostic system named)
decision_a33: eligible under A33 (OnTrackNY coordinated specialty care; non-affective psychosis under two years)
source_page: Nossel et al. 2018, Psychiatr Serv (doi 10.1176/appi.ps.201700436), Results (journal p. 866), work definition journal p. 864; candidate NU16_01
note: Internships counted as paid employment by the report's definition

author: Porteous
diagnosis: First-episode psychosis (EI service admission criteria; drug-induced psychosis excluded)
n_total_basis: programme participants in the contract window
outcome_definition: Full- or part-time employment attained during the contract window 1 June 2002 to 31 May 2004 (Table 2); time since service entry varies
window_status: variable (calendar contract window 1 June 2002 to 31 May 2004)
decision_a24_strict: excluded from strict primary set (A24: bipolar disorder not reported; compatibility not established)
decision_a33: eligible under A33 (early intervention psychosis service)
source_page: Porteous 2007, Br J Occup Ther 70(12):521-526, Table 2 (journal p. 524); candidate NX18_01
note: Standalone variable-window result only; the two contract windows may share participants and are never pooled together; overturns the recorded exclusion reason of X18
